sloka: एवं तेषां निवसतां मासः साग्रो ययौ तदा ।मुहूर्तमिव ते सर्वे रामभक्त्या च मेनिरे ।। ७.३९.२७ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ teṣāṁ nivasatāṁ māsaḥ sāgro yayau tadā ।muhūrtamiva te sarve rāmabhaktyā ca menire ।। 7.39.27 ॥

translations.english: While they were thus dwelling, more than a month passed, yet all of them perceived it as merely a moment due to their profound devotion to Rama.
